duas.title: Durood on the Prophet ﷺ
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا صَلَّيْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ. اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ، كَمَا بَارَكْتَ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلَىٰ آلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، إِنَّكَ حَمِيدٌ مَجِيدٌ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammad, kama sallayta ‘ala Ibrahima wa ‘ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid. Allahumma barik ‘ala Muhammadin wa ‘ala ali Muhammad, kama barakta ‘ala Ibrahima wa ‘ala ali Ibrahim, innaka Hamidun Majid.
duas.english: O Allah, send prayers upon Muhammad and upon the family of Muhammad, as You sent prayers upon Ibrahim and upon the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious. O Allah, bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, as You blessed Ibrahim and the family of Ibrahim. You are indeed Praiseworthy, Glorious.
duas.remark: The salawat he ﷺ taught when they asked how

duas.title: Ayat al-Kursi
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ، لَا تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ، لَهُ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ، مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ، يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ، وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلَّا بِمَا شَاءَ، وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ، وَلَا يَئُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا، وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu la ilaha illa Huwa l-Hayyu l-Qayyum. La ta’khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. Lahu ma fi s-samawati wa ma fi l-ard. Man dha lladhi yashfa‘u ‘indahu illa bi-idhnih. Ya‘lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum, wa la yuhituna bi shay’in min ‘ilmihi illa bima sha’. Wasi‘a kursiyyuhu s-samawati wa l-ard, wa la ya’uduhu hifzuhuma, wa Huwa l-‘Aliyyu l-‘Azim.
duas.english: Allah — there is no god but He, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of all. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what lies before them and what is behind them, and they encompass nothing of His knowledge except what He wills. His Kursī extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation does not weary Him. He is the Most High, the Most Great.

duas.title: Surat al-Ikhlas
duas.arabic:
قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
اللَّهُ الصَّمَدُ
لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌ
duas.transliteration:
Qul Huwa llahu Ahad
Allahu s-Samad
Lam yalid wa lam yulad
Wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad
duas.english: Say: He is Allah, the One. Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, and there is none comparable to Him.

duas.title: Surat al-Falaq
duas.arabic:
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ
مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ النَّفَّاثَاتِ فِي الْعُقَدِ
وَمِنْ شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
duas.transliteration:
Qul a‘udhu bi Rabbi l-falaq
Min sharri ma khalaq
Wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab
Wa min sharri n-naffathati fi l-‘uqad
Wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad
duas.english: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the daybreak — from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.

duas.title: Surat an-Nas
duas.arabic:
قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ
مَلِكِ النَّاسِ
إِلَٰهِ النَّاسِ
مِنْ شَرِّ الْوَسْوَاسِ الْخَنَّاسِ
الَّذِي يُوَسْوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ النَّاسِ
مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ
duas.transliteration:
Qul a‘udhu bi Rabbi n-nas
Maliki n-nas
Ilahi n-nas
Min sharri l-waswasi l-khannas
Alladhi yuwaswisu fi suduri n-nas
Mina l-jinnati wa n-nas
duas.english: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, the Sovereign of mankind, the God of mankind — from the evil of the retreating whisperer who whispers in the breasts of mankind, from among the jinn and mankind.

duas.title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَىٰ عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta Rabbi la ilaha illa anta, khalaqtani wa ana ‘abduk, wa ana ‘ala ‘ahdika wa wa‘dika ma stata‘t. A‘udhu bika min sharri ma sana‘t, abu’u laka bi ni‘matika ‘alayya, wa abu’u bi dhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfiru dh-dhunuba illa ant.
duas.english: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I hold to Your covenant and Your promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me — for none forgives sins but You.
duas.remark: The best way of asking forgiveness

duas.title: Asbahna wa asbaha l-mulku lillah
duas.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَٰذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
duas.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbaha l-mulku lillah, wa l-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illa llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay’in qadir. Rabbi as’aluka khayra ma fi hadha l-yawmi wa khayra ma ba‘dah, wa a‘udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadha l-yawmi wa sharri ma ba‘dah.
duas.english: We have entered the morning and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good that comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that comes after it.

duas.title: Allahumma bika asbahna
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wa bika amsayna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namut, wa ilayka n-nushur.
duas.english: O Allah, by You we enter the morning and by You we enter the evening; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the resurrection.

duas.title: Bismillahi lladhi la yadurru
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahi lladhi la yadurru ma‘a smihi shay’un fi l-ardi wa la fi s-sama’, wa Huwa s-Sami‘u l-‘Alim.
duas.english: In the name of Allah, with whose name nothing in the earth or in the heaven can cause harm, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.

duas.title: Raditu billahi Rabba
duas.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا، وَبِالْإِسْلَامِ دِينًا، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ نَبِيًّا
duas.transliteration: Raditu billahi Rabba, wa bi l-Islami dina, wa bi Muhammadin salla llahu ‘alayhi wa sallama Nabiyya.
duas.english: I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Islam as my religion, and with Muhammad (peace and blessings be upon him) as my Prophet.

duas.title: Subhanallahi wa bihamdih, adada khalqih
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhana llahi wa bi hamdih, ‘adada khalqih, wa rida nafsih, wa zinata ‘arshih, wa midada kalimatih.
duas.english: Glory be to Allah and praise be to Him — as many as the number of His creation, as much as pleases Him, as much as the weight of His Throne, and as much as the ink of His words.
duas.remark: Three times outweighs a whole morning of dhikr

duas.title: Ya Muqalliba l-qulub
duas.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ، ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِي عَلَىٰ دِينِكَ
duas.transliteration: Ya Muqalliba l-qulub, thabbit qalbi ‘ala dinik.
duas.english: O Turner of hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
duas.remark: He ﷺ said it often; the hearts are between two fingers of the Merciful

duas.title: Durood, ten times
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَىٰ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma salli wa sallim ‘ala Nabiyyina Muhammad.
duas.english: O Allah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
duas.remark: Graded ḥasan; ten in the morning and ten in the evening, and my intercession reaches him

duas.title: Amsayna wa amsa l-mulku lillah
duas.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ. رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَٰذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
duas.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsa l-mulku lillah, wa l-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illa llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay’in qadir. Rabbi as’aluka khayra ma fi hadhihi l-laylati wa khayra ma ba‘daha, wa a‘udhu bika min sharri ma fi hadhihi l-laylati wa sharri ma ba‘daha.
duas.english: We have entered the evening and the dominion belongs to Allah. All praise is for Allah. There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner; His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good that comes after it, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil that comes after it.

duas.title: Allahumma bika amsayna
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wa bika asbahna, wa bika nahya, wa bika namut, wa ilayka l-masir.
duas.english: O Allah, by You we enter the evening and by You we enter the morning; by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the final return.

duas.title: A‘udhu bi kalimatillahi t-tammat
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
duas.transliteration: A‘udhu bi kalimati llahi t-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
duas.english: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.
duas.remark: Said in the evening, nothing will harm you that night

duas.title: The last two of al-Baqarah
duas.arabic:
آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنْزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ رَبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ، كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ، لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ، وَقَالُوا سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا، غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ
لَا يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا، لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ، رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِنْ نَسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا، رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْرًا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِنَا، رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ، وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَا، أَنْتَ مَوْلَانَا فَانْصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ
duas.transliteration:
Amana r-Rasulu bima unzila ilayhi min Rabbihi wa l-mu’minun. Kullun amana billahi wa mala’ikatihi wa kutubihi wa rusulih. La nufarriqu bayna ahadin min rusulih. Wa qalu sami‘na wa ata‘na, ghufranaka Rabbana wa ilayka l-masir.
La yukallifu llahu nafsan illa wus‘aha. Laha ma kasabat wa ‘alayha ma ktasabat. Rabbana la tu’akhidhna in nasina aw akhta’na. Rabbana wa la tahmil ‘alayna isran kama hamaltahu ‘ala lladhina min qablina. Rabbana wa la tuhammilna ma la taqata lana bih. Wa‘fu ‘anna, waghfir lana, warhamna. Anta Mawlana fansurna ‘ala l-qawmi l-kafirin.
duas.english:
The Messenger believes in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and so do the believers. Each believes in Allah, His angels, His books and His messengers — we make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say: we hear and we obey; grant us Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the return.
Allah burdens no soul beyond its capacity. It has what it has earned, and against it what it has brought upon itself. Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or fall into error. Our Lord, do not lay upon us a burden like the one You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, do not burden us with more than we can bear. Pardon us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are our Protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
duas.remark: Whoever reads them at night, they suffice him

duas.title: Subhanallah
duas.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Subhanallah.
duas.english: Glory be to Allah.
duas.remark: The tasbih of Fatima, at bedtime

duas.title: Alhamdulillah
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillah.
duas.english: All praise is for Allah.

duas.title: Allahu akbar
duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu akbar.
duas.english: Allah is the Greatest.
duas.remark: Better for the two of you than a servant

duas.title: Allahumma qini adhabak
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ قِنِي عَذَابَكَ يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُ عِبَادَكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma qini ‘adhabaka yawma tab‘athu ‘ibadak.
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from Your punishment on the Day You raise Your servants.
duas.remark: Said with your hand under your cheek

duas.title: Bismika Allahumma amutu wa ahya
duas.arabic: بِاسْمِكَ اللَّهُمَّ أَمُوتُ وَأَحْيَا
duas.transliteration: Bismika llahumma amutu wa ahya.
duas.english: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
duas.remark: Said as you lie down

duas.title: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ، لَا مَلْجَأَ وَلَا مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلَّا إِلَيْكَ، آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ، وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aslamtu nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadtu amri ilayk, wa alja’tu zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk. La malja’a wa la manja minka illa ilayk. Amantu bi kitabika lladhi anzalt, wa bi nabiyyika lladhi arsalt.
duas.english: O Allah, I submit myself to You, entrust my affair to You, and turn my back to You in hope of You and in fear of You. There is no refuge and no escape from You except to You. I believe in Your Book which You revealed and in Your Prophet whom You sent.
duas.remark: Let it be the last thing you say, and you die upon the fitrah

duas.title: Astaghfirullah
duas.arabic: أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
duas.transliteration: Astaghfirullah.
duas.english: I seek the forgiveness of Allah.
duas.remark: Said three times on finishing the prayer

duas.title: Allahumma anta s-Salam
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلَامُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلَامُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلَالِ وَالْإِكْرَامِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta s-Salamu wa minka s-salam, tabarakta ya Dha l-Jalali wa l-Ikram.
duas.english: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace. Blessed are You, Owner of Majesty and Honour.

duas.title: La ilaha illallahu wahdah
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، اللَّهُمَّ لَا مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلَا مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلَا يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay’in qadir. Allahumma la mani‘a lima a‘tayt, wa la mu‘tiya lima mana‘t, wa la yanfa‘u dha l-jaddi minka l-jadd.
duas.english: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. O Allah, none can withhold what You give, and none can give what You withhold, and no fortune can avail its owner against You.

duas.title: Lahu n-ni‘matu wa lahu l-fadl
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، وَلَا نَعْبُدُ إِلَّا إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ الدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُونَ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay’in qadir. La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. La ilaha illa llah, wa la na‘budu illa iyyah. Lahu n-ni‘matu wa lahu l-fadlu wa lahu th-thana’u l-hasan. La ilaha illa llahu mukhlisina lahu d-dina wa law kariha l-kafirun.
duas.english: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable. There is no might and no power except with Allah. There is no god but Allah, and we worship none but Him. His is the favour, His is the bounty, and His is the excellent praise. There is no god but Allah — we are sincere to Him in religion, however much the disbelievers dislike it.

duas.title: Allahumma a‘inni ala dhikrik
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَعِنِّي عَلَىٰ ذِكْرِكَ وَشُكْرِكَ وَحُسْنِ عِبَادَتِكَ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma a‘inni ‘ala dhikrika wa shukrika wa husni ‘ibadatik.
duas.english: O Allah, help me to remember You, to thank You, and to worship You well.
duas.remark: The Prophet ﷺ told Muʿādh never to leave this after any prayer

duas.title: A‘udhu bika mina l-bukhl
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ أَنْ أُرَدَّ إِلَىٰ أَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika mina l-bukhl, wa a‘udhu bika mina l-jubn, wa a‘udhu bika min an uradda ila ardhali l-‘umur, wa a‘udhu bika min fitnati d-dunya, wa a‘udhu bika min ‘adhabi l-qabr.
duas.english: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice, and I seek refuge in You from being returned to the feeblest age, and I seek refuge in You from the trials of this world, and I seek refuge in You from the punishment of the grave.

duas.title: Completing the hundred
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamdu wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay’in qadir.
duas.english: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He is over all things capable.
duas.remark: The hundredth, and his sins are forgiven

duas.title: The ten, after Fajr and Maghrib
duas.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ، يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ، وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
duas.transliteration: La ilaha illa llahu wahdahu la sharika lah, lahu l-mulku wa lahu l-hamd, yuhyi wa yumit, wa huwa ‘ala kulli shay’in qadir.
duas.english: There is no god but Allah alone, with no partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things capable.

duas.title: Allahumma ajirni mina n-nar
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajirni mina n-nar.
duas.english: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.
duas.remark: After Fajr and Maghrib, before speaking

duas.title: Ilman nafi‘an
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as’aluka ‘ilman nafi‘a, wa rizqan tayyiba, wa ‘amalan mutaqabbala.
duas.english: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision, and deeds that are accepted.
duas.remark: Said after Fajr

duas.title: Leaving the house
duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ، تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللهِ، وَلَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللهِ
duas.transliteration: Bismillah, tawakkaltu ‘alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah.
duas.english: In the name of Allah. I place my trust in Allah, and there is no might nor power except with Allah.
duas.remark: Said as you step out of the door

duas.title: Setting off
duas.arabic:
اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ، اللهُ أَكْبَرُ
سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى، وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى
اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا، وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ
اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ، وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الْأَهْلِ
اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ، وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ، وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِي الْمَالِ وَالْأَهْلِ
duas.transliteration:
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar.
Subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin, wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun.
Allahumma inna nas’aluka fi safarina hadha al-birra wat-taqwa, wa minal-‘amali ma tarda.
Allahumma hawwin ‘alayna safarana hadha, watwi ‘anna bu‘dah.
Allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar, wal-khalifatu fil-ahl.
Allahumma inni a‘udhu bika min wa‘tha’is-safar, wa ka’abatil-manzar, wa su’il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl.
duas.english: Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest, Allah is the greatest. Glory be to Him who has placed this at our service, for we could never have managed it ourselves — and to our Lord we are surely returning. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian of the family left behind. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of the journey, from a grim sight, and from an ill return in wealth and family.
duas.remark: Said once seated, as you set off

duas.title: After the adhan
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma rabba hadhihid-da‘watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa’imah, ati Muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab‘athhu maqaman mahmudanil-ladhi wa‘adtah.
duas.english: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the prayer about to be established, grant Muhammad the Wasilah and the virtue, and raise him to the praised station You promised him.

duas.title: Seeking refuge
duas.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Aʿudhu billahi minash-shaytanir-rajim
duas.english: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan, the accursed

duas.title: Waking up
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ahyana baʿda ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.english: Praise is to Allah who gave us life after He caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection

duas.title: The returned soul
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي عَافَانِي فِي جَسَدِي وَرَدَّ عَلَيَّ رُوحِي وَأَذِنَ لِي بِذِكْرِهِ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahil-ladhi ʿafani fi jasadi wa radda ʿalayya ruhi wa adhina li bi dhikrih
duas.english: Praise is to Allah who restored well-being to my body, returned my soul to me, and granted me permission to remember Him
duas.remark: Graded ḥasan
